description: fails without any SBOM setup; the fix adds the include, the stage, both app jobs and a server job per deploy environment

files..gitlab-ci.yml:
include:
  - project: "limenet/ci-cd-templates"
    ref: master
    file: "laravel/deploy.yml"
  - project: "limenet/ci-cd-templates"
    ref: master
    file: "laravel/sbom.yml"

stages:
  - build
  - deploy
  - sbom

variables:
  PHP_VERSION: "8.5"
  DEPLOY_HOST: "207.154.226.19"

# Staging lives on its own server.
deploy_stage:
  extends:
    - .deploy_default_branch
  variables:
    DEPLOY_HOST: "46.224.38.140"

deploy:
  extends:
    - .deploy_tagged

sbom:php:
  extends:
    - .sbom_php

sbom:npm:
  extends:
    - .sbom_npm

sbom:server_staging:
  extends:
    - .sbom_server
  environment:
    name: staging
    action: prepare
  variables:
    DEPLOY_HOST: "46.224.38.140"
    SBOM_SERVER_NAME: staging

sbom:server_production:
  extends:
    - .sbom_server
  environment:
    name: production
    action: prepare
  variables:
    SBOM_SERVER_NAME: production
